result:
M3 is done. Summary of what changed:

**Implementation** (`erasmus-core`):
- `PathImpl`/`NodeImpl` — paths now accumulate one node per cascade level (`"address.city"`) instead of a single segment.
- `PropertyMetadata` + `ConstraintMetadataBuilder` — track `@Valid` per property (a property can be cascaded with no constraints of its own).
- `ConstraintDescriptorImpl.getGroups()` — reads the real `groups()` attribute (empty → `Default`) instead of the hardcoded stub.
- New `GroupExpansion` — group inheritance via `Class.getInterfaces()`.
- New `GroupSequenceResolver` — turns a `validate(bean, groups...)` call into an ordered `Step` plan, unifying bean-level `@GroupSequence` redefinition of `Default` and a standalone `@GroupSequence`-annotated marker interface passed explicitly.
- `ErasmusValidator` — recursive `cascadeValidate` with `IdentityHashMap`-based cycle detection (fresh per group-step, per top-level call), group filtering wired into `validate`/`validateProperty`/`validateValue` via a shared `evaluateGroupSteps` helper, short-circuiting per sequence id. `@Valid` on `Collection`/`Map`/array/`Optional` is a documented no-op (deferred to M4).

**Tests**: new `GraphValidationTest` (13 tests: cascading, cycles/self-reference, groups, group inheritance, both `@GroupSequence` forms, mixed cascading+groups) — all 89 tests in `erasmus-core` green, full reactor still builds.

**Docs**: `ROADMAP.md`'s M3 section updated with actual status and the two narrowed-scope notes (container-element cascading deferred to M4; no sequence-of-sequences); new making-of post `doc/making-of/03-graph-validation-groups-and-sequences.md` added and indexed in `MAKING-OF.md`.

Nothing committed to git, per your instructions — changes are sitting in the working tree if you want to review before committing.
